enforceMode.name: Behavior on exceed
enforceMode.hint: Block (cancel) or only warn when a container would exceed capacity.

includeNested.name: Include nested containers
includeNested.hint: Count what sits inside sub-containers toward a container's capacity. When off, a sub-container counts by its own weight only - for both the capacity check and the capacity bar. Carried weight is not affected.

logLevel.name: Log level
logLevel.hint: Set the logging level for diagnostics.

logStacks.name: Include stack traces
logStacks.hint: Include stack traces in log entries.

logBufferLimit.name: Log buffer size
logBufferLimit.hint: Maximum number of log entries kept in memory buffer.

exceedMessageText.name: Custom exceed notification
exceedMessageText.hint: Replaces the capacity message for everyone. Placeholders: {containerName}, {before}, {delta}, {capacity}, {unit}. Leave empty for the default message.

configDialog.title: Container Rules
configDialog.saveFailed: Could not save the container rule. See the console for details.

allowedTypes.label: Allowed item types
allowedTypes.shortHint: An empty selection allows all item types.

allowedSubtypes.label: Allowed categories/subtypes
allowedSubtypes.shortHint: Available categories follow the selected item types.

requiredProperties.label: Required properties
requiredProperties.hint: All selected dnd5e item properties must be present. Leave empty to require none.
requiredProperties.shortHint: An empty selection requires no properties.

forbiddenProperties.label: Forbidden properties
forbiddenProperties.hint: Items containing any selected dnd5e property are rejected.
forbiddenProperties.shortHint: An empty selection forbids no properties.

matchMode.label: Required property matching
matchMode.hint: Controls how required properties are matched. Forbidden properties always reject on any match.

configDialog.unavailableSubtypes: {count} selected values no longer match the allowed item types.
configDialog.propertyConflict: The following properties are both required and forbidden: {properties}.

summary.title: Rule summary
summary.reduction: This container reduces counted weight by {pct}%.
summary.anyTypes: Items of any type are allowed.
summary.requiredAll: Items must have all of these properties: {values}.
summary.requiredAny: Items must have at least one of these properties: {values}.
summary.forbidden: Items must not have any of these properties: {values}.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.message: There are unsaved changes to this container rule.

configDialog.readOnly: Read-only view - only a Gamemaster can change these rules.
configDialog.changedElsewhere: The rules of "{containerName}" were changed by someone else. Saving now will overwrite them.

reductionDialog.label: Reduction (%)
reductionDialog.errorNoItem: No container item found for reduction dialog.

notifyScope.name: Who sees rejections
notifyScope.hint: Who is notified when a container rejects an item.

presets.label: Presets
presets.hint: A preset only changes the settings it covers. Other modules can add their own.

theme.name: Window theme
theme.hint: Theme for this module’s own windows. Auto follows Foundry, which can in turn follow your operating system.
theme.label: Theme
